blocks.content: Write a program to iterate through a stack. Also, print and pop the top element in each loop iteration.

items: Declare a string stack called fast_food.
Add the strings Burger, Pizza, and Hot Dog to the stack.
Create a while loop that runs while the stack is not empty by using the empty() function.
Inside the loop, print the top element using top() and then remove it using pop().
